NOAA-19 AVHRR Channel 2

Note: Recently, in May 2010, it was detected that NOAA-19 Ch2 calibration coefficients from May 2009
      through April 2010, were erroneous. The errors are identified and fixed for all the affected
      coefficients. This web page is updated by replacing all the affected coefficients in the past 
      with correct values.
